title: Client filter defaults: the resting sentinel and its consumers, the stakeholder function fixed on memberProjectIdsFor (OQ1 answered); scoped-All callers, saved-view fate and the per-person choice still blocked on OQ3, OQ8 and OQ5

approvals.evidence: Architect approval stated in the Claude Code session ("Approve it once version 2 lands", 2026-09-05) after OQ1 was answered as BR8. Touches lib/types.ts, lib/workspace.ts and lib/access.ts; no migration. Steps 5-8 and 10-12 remain blocked on OQ3, OQ5 and OQ8 and are not authorised to build until a version 3 answers them.

body.design_ref: docs/adr/0002-client-filter-stakeholder-scope.md (ART-20260905-006); specification ART-20260905-016 version 2, which supersedes ART-20260905-004 by recording the product owner's answer to OQ1 as BR8: a stakeholder is a person with a live ProjectMember row on the project (personId matches, removedAt null, project role ignored), the definition the read gate already uses through memberProjectIdsFor (lib/projectBoundary.ts:88). AC14 and AC16 are retired; AC15 is definite. This version replaces the four steps version 1 titled BLOCKED ON OQ1: steps 3 and 4 become real (the function is memberProjectIdsFor and nothing is added beside it; scenarios pin AC15 and the definite half of AC2), while steps 5 and 12 stay blocked because they also needed OQ3, OQ4, OQ9, OQ10 and OQ11, which ART-20260905-016 still lists open. Every other step is carried from version 1 unchanged in substance. Baseline confirmed in this planning session on 2026-09-05: npm run audit:contracts green over 14 artifacts; npm run validate:scenarios 192 PASS with no CD-prefixed scenario; the step 3 verify command below was dry-run against the current lib/projectBoundary.ts and exits 0 on its function half and 1 on its comment half, so it has teeth. npx tsc --noEmit clean is version 1's record and was not re-run here.

steps.title: NO_CLIENT_CHOSEN sentinel on FilterState.client (lib/types.ts, beside EMPTY_FILTERS at :381): an exported typed constant that is neither 'All' nor the Discipline facet's 'None' (BR7); EMPTY_FILTERS.client rests on it; matchesFilters (lib/tree.ts:387) returns false for every issue row at the sentinel and visibleRows (lib/tree.ts:489) keeps no structural row either (BR2 deny-by-default); the discipline 'None' branch at lib/tree.ts:394 and every 'All' branch are left meaning what they mean today until step 5 is unblocked. OQ2 changes how often this state is seen, not what it is, so it does not block this step. Highest regression risk: every consumer that compares to the literal 'All' and parseSavedFilters' spread of EMPTY_FILTERS pick the sentinel up silently, which is why steps 1, 2 and 9 ship in one commit.

Scenario CD1 in scripts/scenario-validation.ts (after AA3, ~line 10053; CD is an unused prefix, confirmed this session): against BASE and buildTree, EMPTY_FILTERS lists no issue row and no structural row through visibleRows; {...EMPTY_FILTERS, client: 'All'} lists the fixture's issues exactly as today; {...EMPTY_FILTERS, client: 'All', discipline: 'None'} still returns the rows without a discipline, proving the two tokens are not shared; EMPTY_FILTERS.client is neither 'All' nor 'None'. PASS count today is 192 (confirmed this session); CD1 makes 193.
steps.verify_command: npm run validate:scenarios 2>&1 | awk '/^CD1[[:space:]]+PASS/{f=1} /^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+PASS[[:space:]]/{n++} END{exit !(f && n==193)}'

steps.title: The one pure stakeholder function (BR1, BR8, ADR decision 2) IS memberProjectIdsFor (lib/projectBoundary.ts:88) and nothing is added beside it: OQ1 landed on definition (d) ProjectMember, so the signature stays (state, personId) with no 'today' parameter because the definition is not date-bounded. The only edit is the doc comment at :87, which today reads 'live member' and now states the rule the Client filter reads (personId matches, removedAt null, projectRoleId ignored; Allocation, engagement names and SOW names confer nothing) and names this function as the single stakeholder definition for the Client filter, its facets, scopeLabel and scenarios, so nobody adds a second beside it. No behaviour change: the read gate at lib/db/boot.ts:418 and the boot banner at :201 keep calling it unchanged (BR8's 'never widened or narrowed'). Verified by exercising the function on a three-row fixture (live row in, removedAt row out, another person's row out, null personId empty), by the export count staying at two, and by the comment naming the stakeholder rule.

steps.title: Scenarios CD2 and CD3 in scripts/scenario-validation.ts after CD1. CD2 pins AC15: a fixture with the signed-in person on project P (removedAt set, PROJROLE_SPONSOR) and on project Q (removedAt null, PROJROLE_CUSTOMER); memberProjectIdsFor(state, personId) is exactly {Q}; changing the projectRoleId on either row changes nothing; clearing P's removedAt puts P back in; a null personId gives the empty set (BR2). CD3 pins the definite half of AC2 and BR8 for a non-exempt seat: over a fixture whose issues all sit under a project-tier node (so the ungated no-project-ancestor case OQ11 still owns does not enter), projectView(state, memberProjectIdsFor(state, p)) drops every issue whose projectOf is P2 and keeps every issue under P1, and facetsOf(...) over that redacted state lists exactly the client names of the projects p is live on, so the filter agrees with the payload rather than computing a second set. CD3 asserts what the read gate already does; it is the proof AC2 asks for under definition (d), not a claim that step 5's callers have changed. PASS count 193 after step 2; CD2 and CD3 make 195.

steps.title: BLOCKED ON OQ3: the callers - facetsOf (lib/tree.ts:351), matchesFilters and visibleRows take the stakeholder project set from memberProjectIdsFor (step 3, OQ1 now answered) so that 'All' means scoped-All (AC2, AC3, AC4, AC5), with project ancestry through projectOf/tiersOf and never a literal kind. For a non-exempt seat the payload is already scoped by the read gate, so what this step actually changes is decided by the questions still open: OQ3 (does scoped-All narrow the dropdown options, the rows, or both), OQ4 (is an explicit client selection scoped), OQ10 (unresolved actors: empty-with-reason or today's view) and OQ11 (exempt seats; records with no project-tier ancestor). Without those, the only definite content is what CD3 already proves.

Resting-state UI for the sentinel (AC1; AC13's sentinel half; BR7): FilterDropdown for name='client' offers the resting option with an instructing caption such as 'Client: choose one' instead of 'Client: All', never the bare word 'None', keeps an 'All' option, and takes the on-accent only when the value is neither (components/FilterBar.tsx:63-65; the generic 'v !== All' tests at FilterBar.tsx:193 and :204 exclude the sentinel); FiltersHeader's activeCount and start-expanded rule ignore the sentinel (components/FiltersHeader.tsx:29-32) while shown/total keep reporting the full total; TreeGrid's empty branch (components/TreeGrid.tsx:477) shows a one-line prompt naming the next action when client rests at the sentinel, distinct from 'No issues match the current filters'; scopeLabel (components/IssueWorkspace.tsx:1739) states 'No client chosen' rather than 'All clients - <org>' at the sentinel; openClientPack (IssueWorkspace.tsx:1779) refuses the sentinel with the same teaching message it uses for 'All'. Clear and revealIssue are NOT changed here (step 10). Board and Calendar receive the same empty row set; if either needs its own prompt, re-plan rather than widen ownership. Manual check: Tree, Board and Calendar open on the prompt; choosing a client lists rows; a client seat (GA1) is unchanged.

body.rollback: Revert the commits in reverse order; no schema change. Three cautions. (1) Reverting the step 1/2/9 commit restores 'All' as the resting client value for every internal seat, which is the pre-change behaviour, not a data loss. (2) Reverting the step 3/4 commit removes a doc comment and two scenarios and changes no behaviour; the read gate never stopped calling memberProjectIdsFor. (3) A clientChoices key already written into a tenant's OperatingModel JSON by step 7 rides along after a revert, because mergeModel spreads stored wholesale (lib/config.ts:1609), and a reverted clientView no longer withholds it from client seats; so a rollback of step 7 after any tenant has written must also strip the key from each tenant's OperatingModel row, or the revert lands before any write.
